the Gemara's own voice: מתניתין מני? רבי יוסי היא, דתניא

props.gloss_en: what is a tevallul? white that cuts across the iris-ring [into the black]
whose is the mishna? it is R' Yosei's
white entering the black -- it is a blemish
black entering the white -- it is a blemish
for there are no blemishes in the white [of the eye]
R' Yosei's reason: as it is written 'their eyes stand out from fat' (Tehillim 73:7)
[the white] is called 'the fat of the eye'
R' Meir's reason: what is the sense of 'tevallul'? a thing that confuses (mevalbel) the eyes
